items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Miss Southern who was the instructor, had me to get up and work the examples on the narcotics

ctx.x: Yes, I did. And some of the girls who were taking the psychometric test, they couldn't pass it. They flunked it, and they had just come out of high school. And when we were doing the problems on narcotics, I hope to tell you, Miss Southern who was the instructor, had me to get up and work the examples on the narcotics, to show them how they should be done. All right, now.
